statement: Pinned HHD virtual-uinput output constants list Nintendo Joy-Con left/right, pair and grip VID/PID identities, but those output definitions do not establish a Joy-Con input consumer or native HID protocol parser.

applicability.revision: SDL2 release-2.30.12 at 8236e01; SDL3 at 535d80b; Linux v5.16 df0cc57 and later 4056b3c; joycond 0df025a; HHD 4184f03; all source-only
applicability.scope: HHD source is an output identity table only; input backend behavior unknown.
